clue.text: Not allowing for offers being made

parts.note: at an auction, bidding is the making of offers

explanation.surface: Someone refuses a sale while bids keep coming in.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbidding something is prohibiting it, the act of refusing permission.

clue.text: In truth many will get covered with grease

indicators.note: the word for many is wrapped all round by the word for grease, so one sits inside the other

parts.note: fat is grease, as in cooking fat
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many

explanation.surface: A sober claim that plenty of things end up coated in grease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' is a link here, as in the phrase 'in truth'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fact is something true, a piece of reality rather than opinion.

clue.text: Marine upset over the German excess

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed over another comes before it
upset means the letters of the word Marine are knocked over into a new order

parts.note: der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: A marine is distressed about some German's excesses.
explanation.definitionFit: A remainder is what is left over, a surplus beyond what was needed.

clue.text: Road up-time to make representation!

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for road is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI in crosswords
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Time for the road to be dug up, so a picture is drawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns MI (the M1, the motorway from London to Leeds) into IM.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness of something.

clue.text: Suspect calls about debt

indicators.note: the word for calls goes round the word for debt, enclosing it

parts.note: to dub someone is to call or name them
an IOU is a written acknowledgement of a debt

explanation.surface: Someone suspicious phones about money owed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dubious is doubtful or questionable, inviting suspicion.

clue.text: It's most stylish to take meals in the home

indicators.note: the word for take meals is placed inside the word for the home

parts.note: a nest is a home, as in a cosy nest
to take meals is to eat

explanation.surface: It is the height of fashion to dine at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatest is the superlative of neat, meaning smart and tidy in appearance.

clue.text: Lying article written by graduate

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
a BEd is a Bachelor of Education, a graduate in teaching

explanation.surface: A piece of writing composed by a university graduate.
explanation.definitionFit: Abed is an old word for in bed, reclining rather than standing.

clue.text: A shrub the gardener may well put to good use

definitions.text: the gardener may well put to good use

explanation.surface: A gardener tends a bush that comes in handy.
explanation.definitionFit: Broom is a yellow-flowered shrub, and also a long-handled sweeping brush a gardener uses on paths.

clue.text: Worried after a visit to the hairdresser?

definitions.text: Worried after a visit to the hairdresser?

parts.words: Worried after a visit to the hairdresser?
parts.note: split as ..., someone whose tresses (locks of hair) have been dealt with by the hairdresser

explanation.surface: A customer frets about a new haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: Distressed means anxious or upset, and tresses are long locks of hair.

clue.text: The way a board may be presented

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
a table is a board, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A guide to how a committee should be displayed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something statable can be stated, put forward in words.

clue.text: Pause in mid-sentence

parts.note: a punctuation mark that tells a reader to stop briefly inside a sentence

explanation.surface: A speaker stops halfway through what they were saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A comma marks a short break within a sentence when read aloud.

clue.text: Appealing for reform, see about encompassing the most acceptable

indicators.note: the letters of see about surround the letter for acceptable before they are mixed
the letters are up for reform, so they are reshaped into a new order

parts.note: U means upper-class and so socially acceptable

explanation.surface: A campaigner appeals for reform and checks on the best options.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for reform' rearranges SEEABOUT around U, nine letters in all.
explanation.definitionFit: Beauteous is a poetic word for beautiful, attractive to look at.

clue.text: Feel a yearning about one for a certain tree-fruit

parts.note: to pine is to yearn or long for something
c is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Longing for a single fruit from a particular tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A cone is the seed-bearing fruit of a pine, a conifer.

clue.text: Give up backing the guy who counts the seconds

definitions.text: the guy who counts the seconds

indicators.note: backing means the word for give up is read in reverse

parts.note: to remit is to give up or surrender, as in remitting a debt

explanation.surface: A man counting down the final seconds is told to give up.
explanation.definitionFit: A timer is a person or device that measures elapsed time.

clue.text: The seat of government was nothing out of the ordinary

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the letters of the word nothing are taken out of their ordinary order

explanation.surface: A dull parliament where nothing special happened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of the ordinary' rearranges NOTHING into HINGTON.
explanation.definitionFit: Washington DC is the capital of the United States, where its federal government sits.

clue.text: Making a note to prepare a speech

parts.note: D is a musical note
to dress is to prepare, as in dressing a salad or a chicken

explanation.surface: Jotting something down in readiness for a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal talk given to an audience.

clue.text: Basis for action

parts.note: action in the legal sense of a lawsuit, which is built on proof presented in court

explanation.surface: The grounds for doing something.
explanation.definitionFit: Evidence is the proof that a court case rests upon.

clue.text: Thanks would be given by minstrels for such clothing

parts.note: ta is British slang for thank you
bards are poets and singers, like minstrels

explanation.surface: Travelling singers are thanked with medieval garments.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabard is a sleeveless tunic, worn by heralds and medieval knights.

clue.text: Vacation no one returns after makes for hard times

indicators.note: the reversed pieces come after the word for vacation

parts.note: a recess is a break or holiday, as in a parliamentary recess

indicators.note: returns means the two words no and one are read backwards together

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Holidays with nobody coming back mean lean times.
explanation.definitionFit: A recession is an economic slump, a period of falling trade.

clue.text: An annoying bird?

parts.note: to harry is to pester, so a bird that harries would be a pest; the bird of prey's name is built on that verb

explanation.surface: A bird that gets on everyone's nerves.
explanation.definitionFit: The harrier is a bird of prey, and to harry is to harass.

clue.text: Push a liveried servant into destructive behaviour

parts.note: to ram is to push forcefully
a page is a young servant, often in uniform livery

explanation.surface: A uniformed footman is shoved into a violent spree.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampage is a spell of violent, wild conduct.

clue.text: Sweet stuff will be found in the centre-a clear liquid

indicators.note: the answer is found inside the run of letters that follows, spanning words

explanation.surface: Something sugary lies at the heart of a transparent fluid.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle is a thick syrup made from refining sugar.

clue.text: 25% of a greedy beast's support

parts.note: the greedy beast is a pig, standing on four feet, so one foot is a quarter of what holds it up

explanation.surface: A fraction of what keeps a glutton standing.
explanation.definitionFit: A pig's foot is called a trotter, and a pig has four.

clue.text: Cultivating a vine is simple

indicators.note: cultivating suggests working the letters of a vine over into a new form

explanation.surface: Growing grapes is easy work.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive means innocent and unsophisticated, lacking guile.

clue.text: Ernie could be the making of her!

indicators.note: the letters of Ernie could be remade into another name

explanation.surface: Ernie might be the man who makes a success of her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be the making of' rearranges ERNIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Irene is a girl's name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: Naturally there's no night-time illumination

parts.note: natural light at night comes from one source in the sky, and here it is absent

explanation.surface: Of course, it's dark at night.
explanation.definitionFit: A night is moonless when the moon is not visible to light the sky.

clue.text: The inexperienced driver, if followed by fools, dawdles

indicators.note: the word for fools comes straight after the letter for the learner driver

parts.note: L is for learner, the plate on a British learner driver's car
oafs are clumsy fools

explanation.surface: A learner driver held up by idiots crawls along.
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf is to idle or hang about doing nothing.

clue.text: Hash will be offered in the canteen

explanation.surface: Rehashed food served up in the dining hall.
explanation.definitionFit: A muddle is a hash, and a mess is the dining hall where service personnel eat.

clue.text: Keen to ditch a social worker

parts.note: a trench is a ditch
an ant is a social insect and a worker in its colony

explanation.surface: Eager to get rid of a welfare officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ditch' looks like a verb, but it is a noun giving TRENCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant means incisive and sharp, as a keen blade is.

clue.text: Quick drink around tea-time

indicators.note: the word for drink goes round the time given as a Roman numeral

parts.note: ale is beer, a drink
four o'clock is traditional British tea-time, and IV is the Roman numeral for four

explanation.surface: A quick beer at around four in the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: Quick is an old word for living, as in the quick and the dead.

clue.text: Bearing with a pressman causing distress

parts.note: NE, north-east, is a compass bearing
ed is short for editor, a newspaper man

explanation.surface: A journalist's attitude upsets people.
explanation.definitionFit: Need means hardship or poverty, as in those in need.

clue.text: Objects to going around before shows

indicators.note: the word for objects to is put around the word for before

parts.note: to resent something is to object to it
pre is a prefix meaning before

explanation.surface: Someone complains about travelling ahead of a performance.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent is to depict or portray, showing something.
